pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark pigmented regions exhibit an irregular polygonal geometry. In the central focal plane, individual patches show sharp pixel gradients at their edges, while peripheral regions transition into smooth gradients due to depth-of-field effects. The spatial area of individual patches is relatively large and consistent across the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light cream-colored negative space forms a continuous topological network. Pixel thickness of the pathways is non-uniform, narrowing at some junctions and widening into broader channels elsewhere. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent and quadrivalent.
